title: Prioritized Call List: 80 Open Outreach Tasks
description: 80 outreach tasks are open on your list, ranked by the population-health risk tier so the highest-risk, hardest-to-reach patients come first. 60 patients across the service area currently score in the high-risk tier, and the ranked order is rebuilt on every data refresh.

title: Non-Responders Approaching the 24-Hour Cut-Off
description: 39 reminder messages are still pending a reply. When the cut-off passes with no confirm, reschedule, or telehealth switch, each becomes a call task on your list, ranked by risk tier — that is the escalation path for patients who do not respond to automated touches.

title: High-Risk Patients Without a Reachable Channel
description: Of 200 patients, 103 have no documented SMS consent, and some share a phone or have no mobile at all. For these patients the reminder plan falls back to voice calls or to you — no SMS is ever sent without consent, and no message goes out between 8pm and 8am.
